content.text:
I haven't changed any code yet, so what you're seeing is the same behavior as before. Last time I couldn't reproduce the bug and stopped there.

This time I looked at the meetings the app saved to try to reproduce it from real data. That didn't work either. The app's database (`~/Library/Application Support/natively/natively.db`) has 24 meetings, and the newest is from May 27. I also searched every saved transcript for lines like "will send", "will share", "will follow up" and "I'll send", and found none. So the meeting where Priya's task went missing isn't stored there. It may have run from a dev build that saves somewhere else, or it wasn't saved at all. I worked from a temporary copy of the database and deleted it afterwards.

What I know from the code hasn't changed. Nothing in the code removes undated items. If they're missing, the model is leaving them out. The two prompts that build the recap when a meeting ends (`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts:194` and `GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT` in `electron/llm/prompts.ts:370`) never say to keep tasks that have no date. The Groq one also only shows a dated example ("by Wednesday").

Either of these gets us moving:
1. **Help me reproduce it.** Paste a recap that's missing the task, with the transcript lines around "Priya will send the contract", and tell me which AI provider you're on. Then I can confirm the cause before I change anything.
2. **Make the change without reproducing it.** I add "keep every task that has a person on it, even with no date, and mark it 'no date given'" to both prompts and add an undated example. It's a small change, but I'd be making it without seeing the bug first.

Which do you want?
